title: Employ staff under the Alpine Resorts Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Alpine Resorts Award 2020.

sources.title: Alpine Resorts Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers employers throughout Australia who operate an alpine resort and their employees employed at, or in direct connection with the operation of, the alpine resort in the classifications within Schedule A —Classification Definitions to the exclusion of any other modern award.

reach.note: National system employers that are companies, in every state.

sources.title: Alpine Resorts Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 Alpine resort means a resort which includes, among other things, an alpine lift .

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: Operators of alpine resorts, which include an alpine lift (cl 4.2); matched to the ABS class for ski lift operation.

assessment.summary: The Alpine Resorts Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
